meta.title: Native Collaboration Bundle
meta.description: Community-derived collaboration bundle. Install loads only the management entry. Its own confirmed master switch manages startup overrides; close it before uninstall.

collabUi.title: Collaboration component status
collabUi.summary: Collaboration preferences, component status and the plugin’s own startup-override master switch.
collabUi.statusPlaceholder: Root placeholder, always off. Ordinary tools run inside presets, not in this row.
collabUi.statusRootScope: This table lists only the seven bundle derived roots. It does not report native roots or preset execution. Five derived roots can be active; the two ordinary-tool rows are root placeholders and stay off because those tools run inside presets. Native configured state together with all seven derived rows disabled is expected. Source layer stays unknown because the Host does not publish it.
collabUi.statusReadOnly: Diagnostic only. This table does not write configuration, and it does not treat an unknown source layer as a runtime phase.
collabUi.transactionUnavailable: Safe Profile transaction is unavailable; no change was made.
collabUi.sourceUnknown: Source layer is not reported by the Host.
collabUi.unknownNotice: Some current settings could not be determined.
collabUi.unknownStructure: The Host returned an unsupported status shape; unknown rows are not guessed.
collabUi.statusError: The Host status service is unavailable.
collabUi.capabilityImpact: Derived subagent and subagent_fork default off. Turning one on in the same scope as the official tool replaces that tool name. The control row can save only its six own fields for the next assembly. It does not enable the five or seven rows, write presets, or change native switches. Off mode for model enhancement returns ordinary subagent selection to the native snapshot. On mode uses the compatibility sub-item: native snapshot or the live Host allowlist. These two tool rows are not part of the five-function root enable example.
collabUi.lifecycleInstall: Install enables only the management anchor. Native and derived services are not loaded together; review and confirm changes through the plugin’s own master switch.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.subagent: Enabling derived row dsh-native-collab-subagent replaces native subagent in that scope. Native and derived are not loaded together. If that capability was off, enabling turns it on.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.control: Enabling derived row dsh-native-collab-tool-subagent-control replaces native tool-subagent-control in that scope. Native and derived are not loaded together. If that capability was off, enabling turns it on.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.listAgents: Enabling derived row dsh-native-collab-tool-subagent-list-agents replaces native tool-subagent-list-agents in that scope. Native and derived are not loaded together. If that capability was off, enabling turns it on.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.agentTeam: Enabling derived row dsh-native-collab-agent-team replaces native agent-team in that scope. Native and derived are not loaded together. If that capability was off, enabling turns it on.
collabUi.lifecycleCore.teamTools: Enabling derived row dsh-native-collab-tool-agent-team replaces native tool-agent-team in that scope. Native and derived are not loaded together. If that capability was off, enabling turns it on.
collabUi.lifecycleRestore: Closing the master switch enables native rows and clears derived-row overrides and preferences. It is not a restore of the pre-install state.
collabUi.lifecycleRemove: Removing this plugin while an enable patch remains can leave native rows disabled and derived rows missing. The standard preset may then fail to activate, and tested new and old sessions can be unavailable. That is configuration unavailability, not log or data corruption.
collabUi.lifecycleStep.stop: Close this page’s master switch and confirm a successful write first. Running tasks are not terminated.
collabUi.lifecycleStep.backup: Review the exact rows, modules and scopes. Native capabilities that were originally OFF will also be enabled.
collabUi.lifecycleStep.withdraw: Check Profile, home and --patch overrides. Resolve reported conflicts before reviewing again; never clear the whole configuration blindly.
collabUi.lifecycleStep.verify: Verify that next-start native services are enabled and derived references withdrawn; this is not current runtime status.
collabUi.lifecycleStep.remove:
Stop this Profile’s Host and Agent, then run dsh plugin --profile

remove @dsh-native-collab/derived.
collabUi.lifecycleStep.restart: Restart as the Host requires. Verify S0 pre-install sessions, S1 plugin-period sessions, and a new session.
collabUi.lifecycleSidecar: The budget sidecar is kept by default. Reinstalling the same root reuses its used count. This page does not delete the sidecar, the pnpm store, operation logs, or sessions.
collabUi.lifecycleNotAuto: Official Remove still does not close this switch. This component applies user-confirmed configuration changes only; dispose is not an uninstall hook.
collabUi.settingsSummary: Model, communication and Team request-limit settings; changes require full reassembly.
collabUi.settingsScope: These switches save a preference for the next full assembly. They do not install services, enable other rows, or switch the current Agent.
collabUi.restartRequired: A confirmed effect needs a normal restart and full assembly. This control does not hot-apply.
collabUi.nativeCompatNote: Used only when model enhancement is on. On uses the native snapshot. Off uses the live allowlist. Unset follows the tool row.
collabUi.communicationOffNote: Off keeps native send_message, permissions, and sessions. It does not remove the Team quota guard.
collabUi.quotaRemains: Default: 32 requests per new Team root. Positive safe integers only. After full reassembly, new Team ledgers use this cap. Existing epochs keep their recorded limit and used requests; saving does not refill or resize them.
collabUi.activationBody: The status anchor is active. Underlying collaboration rows stay disabled until you enable them yourself. This dialog does not write settings.
collabUi.modalBasesReady: Listed base rows are enabled in the observed inventory.
collabUi.modalScope: A native standing combination can throw on apply when the preset scope is not verified. Saving this preference is not apply success.
collabUi.write.saved-pending-restart: Saved as the next assembly preference. It is not applied to the current Agent. Restart to confirm.
collabUi.write.settings-missing: Settings are not available. Nothing was written.
collabUi.write.settings-unverified: Settings identity could not be verified. Nothing was written.
collabUi.write.namespace-unverified: The control entry namespace was not uniquely verified. Nothing was written.
collabUi.write.revision-missing: Settings revision is missing. Nothing was written.
collabUi.write.not-writable: Settings are not writable. Nothing was written.
collabUi.write.settings-unavailable: The row form is not ready. Nothing was written.
collabUi.write.rejected: The write was rejected. Nothing else was changed.
collabUi.write.conflict: The settings revision changed. Nothing was written. Re-read before another save.
collabUi.write.field-rejected: A field outside the allowlist was refused.
collabUi.quotaUsageUnknown: Usage belongs to each Team root, not this profile. Inspect that Team’s budget status; no global total is inferred here.
collabUi.modalPresetUnknown: Root rows do not prove preset assembly. Disabled at root does not mean missing inside a preset.

boot.title: Collaboration master switch — startup overrides
boot.scope: This is the plugin’s own switch, not the official Enable/Disable button. Install alone does not replace native services. Review the concrete targets before confirming.
boot.uninstall: Before uninstalling, close this switch, verify the native configuration, stop this Profile’s Host/Agent, and only then remove the bundle. Direct official Remove bypasses this component.
boot.standingNote: Closing and uninstall order are reviewed with the close action. This page does not remove the bundle.
boot.enableIntro: Enable selects derived services for the next start. It does not turn native features on, and it is not a live switch. Confirm only after reviewing the listed targets.
boot.restoreIntro: Close explicitly enables all five native roots — subagent, control, list-agents, agent-team, and team tools — including control and list-agents even if they were originally disabled. This is a fixed enable of those native roots, not a historical restoration.
boot.alreadyEnabled: Already enabled. Repeating enable would only rewrite the same module names, so this button does not open another confirmation and writes nothing.
boot.moduleUnchanged: Module name unchanged. This is not a byte-for-byte no-op; the row may still be rewritten.
boot.presetPin: Enable copies complete preset configs (size depends on your Profile) into this Profile’s overrides and pins later preset changes until you review them. Close changes module names back to native but does not remove those snapshots.
boot.fixed: This applies a fixed target state, not a historical restore. It may turn ON capabilities that were previously OFF. Closing the switch turns native capabilities ON, restores ordinary subagent/fork module names, and clears derived-row overrides including their saved preferences.
boot.restart: The running Host, Agent and tools are NOT switched. Stop/restart this Profile for complete reassembly. No active conversations are migrated or cancelled.
boot.restartBeforeSettings: Startup overrides changed. Stop/restart the Profile and reopen this page before editing preferences; the previous settings view is now stale.
boot.saved: Startup configuration written. Restart required; this is not proof of live switching or uninstall completion.
boot.blocked: Blocked — resolve this condition and review again

warning.next-start-only: Next-start only; no live activation is promised.
warning.original-disabled-state-not-restored: Original disabled states are deliberately not restored.
warning.stop-profile-before-remove: Stop the Profile’s Host and Agent before uninstall.
warning.clears-derived-row-overrides-and-prefere: Closing clears saved derived-row preferences so no missing-row reference survives removal.
warning.native-features-will-be-enabled: Native features will be enabled even if they were previously disabled.
warning.fixed-state-not-history-restore: Fixed-state switching, not a historical restore.
warning.stop-agents-and-restart: Stop Agents and fully restart the Profile to take effect.
warning.remove-only-after-off-and-verification: Close the switch and verify native configuration, then stop Host/Agent before removal.
warning.own-profile-preferences-will-be-cleared: Closing clears derived-row overrides, including preferences, to avoid missing-row references after removal.
warning.remove-external-overlay: An external overlay still references this bundle. Remove that overlay yourself; this switch does not clear it.
